name: Derived Grid Rasterization
aliases: Derived Grid for Unstructured Volume Rendering
Unstructured Volume to Structured Grid Conversion
definition: A technique to rasterize unstructured volume meshes (tetrahedra, hexahedra, etc.) into a structured 3D grid (DerivedGrid) for subsequent volume rendering. It maps cell connectivity to voxel occupancy and stores tetrahedron indices for ray-marching.
